<function name="GetLife" parent="DNotify" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Returns the display time in seconds of the DNotify. This is set with 
<page>DNotify:SetLife</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The display time in seconds.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
